==Usage==
This template should be placed after an objection which is overridden following an [[WP:INQ|Inq]] vote. Inqs who need to use this template simply need to put <nowiki>{{Inqstrike|~~~~~}}</nowiki> (making sure to use five <nowiki>~</nowiki><nowiki>'</nowiki>s) on an approved [[WP:FAN|FAN]].
